verified: All monetary fields of a complete original v6 prior-year-assigned claim are unchanged and calculation has no database effect.
Two planned partial receipts on different dates keep unpaid remainder, deterministic event order and null final tax/contribution/net fields.
A duplicate event across two accepted claims and overconsumption by one cent are rejected.
Employee, month, latest group cutoff and current original calculation remain bound.
Rebuilding a foreign-employer claim plan or an invented current social projection cannot override source checks.

Consumption belonging to another prior receipt group remains present in the yearly room; unrelated person/employer/section is rejected.
limitations: The pure kernel deliberately leaves multiple tax grouping and component contribution allocation unresolved; this is expected behavior.
New v7 receipt events are planned proposals, not accepted payments or claim consumption.
Database authority, freshness, full monthly event enumeration, finalization, payment allocation and later corrections require the private runtime integration and are outside this pure-kernel review.
The separate payroll_multiple_payments.py was not reviewed here.
